faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) for its New Delhi center, focusing on advanced research in yeast engineering and biotechnology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Project Associate I: Yeast Engineering, which is funded by the DBT for specialized projects related to AI-ML-guided strain engineering and biofoundry applications.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate I: Yeast Engineering position. Candidates meeting the required educational criteria are encouraged to apply before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or M.Tech degree in Biotechnology or a related field from a recognized university or institution to be considered eligible for this research position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate I position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate I: Yeast Engineering role will receive a monthly salary of Rs 31,000 plus HRA as per the guidelines and funding agency norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit applications for ICGEB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application via email is 04-10-2026. Applicants should ensure their submissions reach the designated email address well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly via email. Candidates need to send their curriculum vitae and cover letter directly to the designated email address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What should be the subject line of the application email?
faq.answer: The subject line of the application email must strictly be “Application for Project Associate I Biofoundry” to ensure it is correctly identified and reviewed by the recruitment committee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ICGEB Project Associate I?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial short-listing of candidates based on their application details, relevant research experience, followed by an interview conducted for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected Project Associate I: Yeast Engineering candidate is New Delhi, where the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) is located.
